oldScript.headline: First the goodbye. Then the fight.
oldScript.goodbyeBody: Boxes in the landing. The patio does not fit in the flat. You close the window and tell yourself the asado stayed behind.
oldScript.helloBody: The phone face-down. The building chat. Nobody has to shout. Fear is enough.

building.headline: A courtesy, not a permit.
building.quote: Lume does not legalise fire. It makes fire more civil, when fire is allowed.
building.body: The bylaws decide. If charcoal is banned, Lume does not enable it. The note is for the building: what it is, what it does not promise, and that the neighbour stays a neighbour. Forward it as it is.

privacyPage.metaDescription: Why Lume asks for an email and what we do with it.
privacyPage.title: Why we ask for an email
privacyPage.lead: We want to tell you when Lume is ready. That is all.
privacyPage.whatBody: The address you leave. If you want, the country, whether you already have a grill, and whether a neighbour sent you. The date you joined. No phone. No street address.
privacyPage.whyBody: To write when it is ready in Argentina or Spain, and to know where to start. We do not sell the list. We do not build a profile.
privacyPage.leaveBody: Reply to the notice and ask to be removed. We will.
privacyPage.contact: Questions: hola@lumefuego.com — a person, not a bot.

faqPage.metaDescription: Can you grill on a balcony? What Lume is, what it does not promise, and the note for the building.
faqPage.title: What you need to know.
faqPage.lead: The bylaws decide. No miracles. No permits. Here, calmly.
faqPage.q1: Can I make asado on the balcony?
faqPage.a1: It depends on your building rules, and on staying within ordinary neighbourly tolerance. Smoke and smell must not go past that. Lume does not change the rule: it makes fire more civil, when fire is allowed.
faqPage.a2: Lume does not legalise fire. If the building forbids charcoal, this does not enable it. The note for the building says exactly that, so a chairperson can forward it without surprises.
faqPage.a3: No. That aisle is electric plates. Lume captures smoke at the grate — charcoal included — and reduces the plume and odour leaving the balcony. We do not promise a miracle.
faqPage.q4: Do I have to drill the façade?
faqPage.a4: No. No ducts. No drilling into common structure. It is a household appliance, ordinary plug. The cook stays beside it, talking.
faqPage.q5: Does it work on a real grill?
faqPage.a5: It is built for charcoal. If it only worked on induction, it would not be Lume. Use it over your grill, on the balcony, not as a kitchen rangehood in a closed room.
faqPage.q6: What do I tell the building?
faqPage.a6: Send them the note. It is a courtesy, not a permit: what it is, what it does not promise, and that the neighbour stays a neighbour.
faqPage.a7: Not yet. Leave an email and we will write when it is ready in Argentina or Spain.
